bullets.text: Apple's Special Experience Event - Apple is hosting a unique event in New York, London, and Shanghai on March 4.
New Android Backup Feature - Android introduces a local file backup feature via **Google Drive** for enhanced document safety.
visionOS 26.4 Launches Foveated Streaming - New **Apple** update enhances immersive content delivery on **Apple Vision Pro**.
iOS 26.4 Introduces Playlist Playground - **Apple Music** adds AI-driven playlist creation based on user text prompts.
Key Theft Prevention in iOS 26.4 - **Apple** activates Stolen Device Protection by default for enhanced security.
Apple Music & TikTok Collaboration - New features allow TikTok users to play full songs from **Apple Music**.
Samsung Galaxy S26 Launch Approaches - Rumors suggest a free storage upgrade for early adopters at launch.
Samsung's Privacy Display Feature - New **Galaxy S26** display technology promises enhanced privacy for users.
Steam Deck OLED Stock Issues - **Valve**'s Steam Deck OLED faces intermittent stock shortages due to RAM crisis.
Sony's PlayStation Release Delays - **Sony** may postpone its next console release due to memory shortages.
